lines.text: Darius appoints 120 satraps and three administrators, and Daniel stands out, so the king plans to set him over the kingdom.
The officials ask Darius to decree that for thirty days no one may petition any god or man except Nebuchadnezzar.
Daniel keeps praying three times a day at his upper room windows opening toward Jerusalem, and the men report him to the king.
Darius labors until sundown to rescue Daniel, then Daniel is thrown into the den, and the king seals the stone with his ring and spends the night eating a feast.

wrong_details.wrong: spends the night eating a feast

lines.text: At dawn Daniel is found unharmed because God sent His angel, and the men who accused him are thrown to the lions.
